# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 4 Slot 83: 25-Nation Eurasian Destiny Mission Chains (oe_msn_, 300 DAG tasks, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_25_missions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 83 Annual Sync (June O(1) Global Destiny Milestone Coordinator)
# ==============================================================================

# Any country scope (BYZ mainline scheduler Slot 83 or fallback pulse).
oe_msn_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_msn_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_total_completed value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_theater_med_done value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_theater_eeu_done value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_theater_weu_done value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_theater_iio_done value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_theater_eas_done value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_month = 6
			has_global_variable = oe_msn_total_completed
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:oe_msn_total_completed >= 1
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_msn_ev1_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_msn_ev1_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_msn.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:oe_msn_total_completed >= 3
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_msn_ev2_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_msn_ev2_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_msn.2
		}
	}
}

oe_msn_bump_completed = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_msn_total_completed }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_total_completed add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_msn_total_completed value = 1 }
	}
}

oe_msn_bump_theater_med = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_msn_theater_med_done }

	}

	}
}

# Fires both Destiny Coronation & Multipolar Resonance events for Page 80 verification.
oe_msn_dev_fire_destiny_ceremony = {
	oe_msn_bump_completed = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_msn.1
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_msn.2
}

# Opens the full 25-Nation Destiny Missions master console readout (oe_msn.90).
